Materials & Techniques: The Traditional Standard
Hand-Prepared Iconographic Supports Every icon begins with a custom-made board crafted from high-grade Baltic Birch plywood, selected for its exceptional dimensional stability and resistance to warping.
The Authentic Levkas (Gesso) Unlike mass-produced boards that use plastic-based acrylics, I prepare a traditional levkas ground using:
Professional Grade Rabbit Skin Glue: Provides a flexible, organic bond that breathes with the wood.
Natural Chalk and Marble Dust: Applied in 12 to 15 thin layers, then hand-sanded to a glass-like finish.
Time-Honored Durability: This labor-intensive process ensures the surface will not crack or peel, preserving the "written" image for centuries.
